notes: High-level: CutPoint runs real-time bidding/reranking for mid-market SSPs. Extremely latency-sensitive (tight p95 requirement) and cost-constrained.
Primary ask: Can we hit p95 <= 8ms for 128-token reranker model at 5k concurrent QPS with predictable cost?
Interest: dedicated capacity with VPC peering + Optimize recommendations for batching/caching/quantization. Also wants per-route cost breakdowns and token-level tracing.
POC details: will replay production traffic (anonymized) to test batching behavior and KV cache hit rates. Want to trial prefix-KV caching for common user histories.
Perf signals: measuring p50/p95/p99, token throughput, GPU utilization, and tail-latency under mixing workloads. Requesting exporter metrics for in-house Grafana.
Quantization: willing to try int8 and mixed-precision int4 if quality delta (NDCG @ top10) < 0.5%. SE asked for sample eval harness for automated regressions.
Cost sensitivity: procurement target is <$300k ARR with a hard cost-per-1M-requests target; CFO will require modeled numbers based on batching and kv-cache hit assumptions.
Security: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logs forwarded to Splunk, and EU/US residency for certain customers. They requested a security FAQ and penetration test reports.
Quote from CTO on call: 'We need predictable tail latency — we can trade model size for throughput but can't accept noisy p95 spikes.'

Internal notes: recommended next bench variants: (a) smaller transformer qint8, (b) same model with aggressive batching and prefix caching, (c) offload rerank to half-precision variant with fallback on misses. Provide expected cost delta per variant.
notes_summary: Enterprise adtech POC focused on hitting sub-8ms p95 for reranking at scale. Strong interest in dedicted capacity + Optimize (batching/caching/quantization). SOC2 + data residency required. Benchmarks and quantization experiments are gating procurement.
